# Weekly assignments

Post in the Docs team Slack group at the beginning of each week so everyone
knows the owner of each task. Tasks vary every week, so adjust the list. Take
the assignees and reviewers from the responsibilities sign-up sheet.

```text
Hey folks, welcome to week <week number>! :kubernetes-intensifies:

The tasks for this week, along with the assigned owners, are:
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Release Team updates (<meeting link>)
<date> (<day>)
APAC meeting (<time> UTC): @<handle>
EMEA meeting (<time> UTC): @<handle>

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Weekly branch sync PR:
<date> (<day>)
Assignee: @<handle>

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Burndown meetings
<date> (<day>)
APAC (<time> UTC): @<handle>
EMEA (<time> UTC): @<handle>
<date> (<day>)
APAC (<time> UTC): @<handle>
EMEA (<time> UTC): @<handle>

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
v<major>.<minor>.0-<alpha|beta|rc>.<n> release notes
<date> (<day>)
Assignee: @<handle>
Reviewer: @<handle>
```
